subject: Migrate listpack.c unit tests to new framework  (#949)
reason: The change only migrates listpack unit tests to the new test framework: it deletes the #ifdef SERVER_TEST test block from listpack.c (compiled only into test builds, never the shipped server), removes the test declaration from listpack.h and the test-dispatch entry from server.c's serverTests table, and adds the equivalent tests as src/unit/test_listpack.c. No production listpack code or any runtime behaviour changes, so there is no reachable path for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
